scientific_integrity: Complete high-degree (j >= 9) integral persistence classification for the intrinsic closed-ball Čech nerve of the 16-vertex graph G(8,3), verified by an exact standard-library checker and a stated Alexander-duality proof; independence-complex homotopy information predates this claim and is not asserted as novel.
scientific_limitations: Low-degree j < 9 persistence not determined; other graph families not classified; novelty may be limited by unindexed equivalent results; no independent audit.
title: High-dimensional Čech persistence of the Möbius–Kantor graph by Alexander duality
